_comment: Enemy types, SPEC.md §6. Where each enemy stands or walks is in data/map.json; what kind of enemy it is lives here. visionRadius is in hexes before the alert bonus in data/rules.json and any terrain spotBonus at the hex it stands on. arcDegrees is the facing arc (SPEC.md §6: 120). detection is base(enemy) in the detection formula. speed is movement points per enemy phase, spent on the same terrain costs as the troopers pay; 0 means it never moves.
_vehicle: ART-ASSETS.md lists a vehicle counter, but SPEC.md never says what a vehicle does differently, so there is no vehicle type yet.
